about: The minimum-version table: per runtime (its id in app/router/runtimes/table.py), each security advisory, the first version that fixes it, and the advisory. A running version below `fixed` is warned about in Settings, on the Setup tab and in the connector's terminal. Data, not code: add a line here, or point RUNTIME_ADVISORIES_FILE at a copy. Only advisories with a confirmed fixed version belong here. Versions are compared as numbers; llama.cpp's are build numbers (b5662). Checked 2026-09-27. Not listed: runtimes that report no version (text-generation-webui, GPT4All, MLX-LM, Jan, Foundry Local) — an advisory for one could never be checked; docs/RUNTIMES.md names them.

ollama.summary: A crafted model file can read memory out of bounds and send it away through the model push API.
A registry can make it send your ollama.com token to another domain during a pull.
A crafted model can crash the server.
The push API reveals which files exist on the computer.
Path traversal in model pulls lets a malicious registry run code on the computer (Probllama).
A crafted model request can hang the server.
DNS rebinding lets any web page you visit use the local API.

llamacpp.summary: A crafted model's tokenizer can overflow a buffer.
A crafted model's vocabulary can overflow a buffer.

vllm.summary: Prompt embeddings sent to the Completions API can crash the server or run code.
The PyNccl pipe deserialises untrusted data, which runs code.
The Mooncake integration unpickles data from the network, which runs code.

sglang.summary: An unauthenticated message broker unpickles data from the network, which runs code.
